review.baseline_checks: The helper recomputes the pinned 334-source baseline plus current source inventory, verifies the exact 51 relevant UI/build files and 46-file UI/server/plugin set, exact ten output files, controls-to-B01 lock additions/current B01 package records, resolved tool file digests, accepted artifact pins, G5 source bytes, and no frontend/backend connection. Missing, changed, extra, non-regular, or unreadable entries fail closed before tests/builds.
review.capture_and_privacy: The runner captures the exact source map and verifies every captured ZIP entry against it before execution, captures the ten current outputs privately, and rechecks source/tool/protected/output inventories after execution. Raw command logs, child G5 report, and source/build archives remain in a 0700 gate leaf; private files are changed to 0600 in finalization. The promoted report contains hashes, counts, case names/timings and relative paths, not credentials, PIDs, start ticks, or raw service/worker logs.
review.execution_and_limits: The unchanged G5 orchestrator is invoked in-process, preserving its three separate 300-second Python commands and targeted 48-case Node command without a larger wrapper timeout. The runner enforces exact Python counts/statuses, PG stopped/PID-false lifecycle, the 48-case TAP timing ceiling, then the sorted full test glob with concurrency/reporter flags before operands, exact pinned 387-name inventory, zero non-pass outcomes, 30 seconds per callback and 180 seconds total. Build, plugin build, and source verification use the approved separate limits and output equality check.
review.failure_handling: Command timeouts/nonzero exits become gate failures with private raw output retained. The inherited G4 owned-process/subreaper cleanup is invoked on failed runs; G5 keeps its own cluster and child cleanup. Failure paths capture any changed build outputs and private permissions are finalized. The gate never retries tests or relaxes thresholds.
review.scope: Conditional omission remains limited to the existing 11 browser/native-host/UI commands and is only reported eligible after the accepted source/dependency/output checks. The report explicitly leaves G7, original AT and B03-B13 pending.
review.execution_status: Static review only. No G6 tests, builds, services, or PostgreSQL were executed.

approval_boundary: This review authorizes one fresh G6 frozen-candidate gate on the exact reviewed bytes. It is not a G6 pass or acceptance; acceptance still requires the complete passing run, archive/source audit, and independent final review.
